Tests broken: none (every Background has i1 started; the changes apply only to the initiative's name and the integrate kind).
The set drops workqueue.py, supervise_review.py, supervise_faults.py and test_supervision.py from the researcher's set.
Open cases: a faulted round after the transition, a request with no accepted line, no fulfils, initiative log lines read by agrees and measure.
